title: Normalized module-derived Kummer class and its global realization
statement: Let $T$ be any scheme, $A$ a commutative ring with $mA=0$, $m$ invertible on $T$, and $w\in\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)^\times$. Form $\kappa_{T,A}(w)$ by the ordinary abelian Kummer boundary followed by $z\mapsto z\otimes1$ [def-sc-kummer-sequence], [def-pur-relative-kummer-canonical-arrows]. Define its module-derived realization as the unique map $A_T[0]\to L_T[1]$ whose ordinary class is $\kappa_{T,A}(w)$, using the bijection of [lem-sp-ordinary-finite-class-arbitrary-base] and the existing finite line [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist]. More generally, for a module sheaf $F$, every map $A_T[0]\to F[0][q]$ gives $A[0]\to R\Gamma(T,F)[q]$ by the derived constant-sheaf/sections adjunction, the exact-constant single comparison, and the derived-sections shift comparison [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. The constant sheaf is that used in [def-pur-normalized-kummer-global-arrows].
